item.title: [infoq] Agent 编程能力从 10% 飙到 70%，Anthropic 新模型却遭遇灵魂拷问：我什么时候才会用它？
item.description: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5 on September 28, the second model in the Claude 5.5 family, claiming over 30% faster output and up to 30% lower cost per task. It jumped from 10.3% to 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, beating Opus 5.5's published best, while early testers report roughly a third fewer tool calls and about half the shell executions. Base44 measured an average of 3.6 iterations per app build against 7.7 for Opus 5, which matters to teams running coding agents such as Claude Code.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] （古法编程）做了一款全平台掼蛋游戏， flutter, flame 和 soloud。

Daily active users grew from under 10 to roughly 500 with no advertising at all. He walks through several Flame bugs he hit, and says he built it because existing Guandan apps chase money over play experience.

item.description: At its Yunqi Conference, Alibaba Cloud launched Agent Sandbox, described by Wu Jiesheng of its elastic computing team as a "new compute form for intelligence": each sandbox runs as a Kubernetes Pod inside a MicroVM, with identity, network and data controls. A roundtable featuring Alibaba Cloud, AMD, Kingsoft Office and 51job explains why production Agent workloads need this layer on top of Docker and Kubernetes.

item.title: [infoq] Uber 使用子集群重新设计 M3DB 分片策略，降低故障影响
item.description: Uber redesigned shard placement in M3DB, its distributed time-series database, by grouping nodes into fixed-size subclusters that own non-overlapping shard ranges while replicas stay spread across isolation groups. In the old model a single node failure could touch as many as (n-1)/n of the cluster; the new design confines failures, maintenance and scaling to one subcluster, at the cost of requiring equal instance weights and bulk, subcluster-sized expansion.

item.title: [infoq] DeepSeek 开源昇腾平台基础设施组件，覆盖 TileLang、计算库与分布式通信库
item.description: On September 30, DeepSeek open-sourced a set of infrastructure components for Huawei's Ascend platform, covering the TileLang compiler plus Ascend implementations of DeepGEMM, DeepEP, TileKernels, FlashMLA and DeepSelect that map one-to-one onto its earlier NVIDIA releases. The team also worked with Huawei on a 128-card supernode based on Ascend 950. TileLang already implements most operators used in DeepSeek V4 training, and some components keep NVIDIA-level APIs to ease migration.

item.title: [infoq] Java 近期新闻：JDK 27、Open J Proxy、A2A Jakarta、Azul Payara、BoxLang、Netflix ja
item.description: This Java roundup covers the release of JDK 27 with nine finalized JEPs, JDK 28 early-access Build 16, BellSoft's Liberica JDK 27, and the Jakarta EE 12 Core Profile slated for December with Web and Platform specs following next year. Open J Proxy also reached 1.0.0 GA, adding a HikariCP connection-pool leak-detection threshold, a Core JDBC Type 3 driver, and an OmniFish partnership aimed at database scalability in Kubernetes and cloud-native deployments.

item.title: [infoq] 从 AI 试点到营收增长：Snowflake 销售与营销团队如何跨越落地鸿沟 ｜ 技术实践
item.description: Snowflake has published The GTM Leader's Blueprint for AI Transformation, documenting how its own sales and marketing teams apply AI across the customer lifecycle to drive revenue. Its main finding is that the bottleneck is organizational rather than technical: the two functions optimize different goals and rely on different data, so AI only makes the split more visible. Shared data and redesigned cross-team workflows are needed before local productivity gains turn into pipeline.
